Personality: Polykrates, a prominent figure of the Polykratidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Polykrates owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Polykratidai. Historical Record: Polykrates of Argos, who drills the Egyptian phalanx and hopes for a governorship as his reward. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
